# Digital Marketing in Utah: Top Agencies + Skills Employers Want
## **Top 7** **Digital Marketing Agencies in Utah**
### **1. Disruptive Advertising**
Location: 1064 N County Blvd Ste 400, Pleasant Grove

![disruptive, digital marketing agency utah](https://recruitingconnection.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/disruptive-logo.png)

[Disruptive Advertising](https://disruptiveadvertising.com/) recently won the 2025 Marketing Company of the Year at the Silicon Slopes Hall of Fame Awards. They pair their deep expertise in Google and Meta ads with conversion rate optimization, creative strategy, and lifecycle marketing.

It’s one of the digital marketing agencies you start with if you need aggressive, data-backed growth across multiple online channels.

### **2. Big Red Jelly**
Location: 2520 N University Ave, Provo

![big red jelly, digital marketing utah](https://recruitingconnection.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/logo-1.png)

Sending traffic to a poorly designed website drains your budget. [Big Red Jelly](https://bigredjelly.com/), which follows an award-winning _Brand, Build, Grow_ methodology, combines web design, SEO, and PPC to ensure your visual identity and website architecture convert visitors into buyers.

They’re an ideal partner when you need an enterprise-grade digital foundation for a rebrand or a new venture. Clients consistently highlight their collaborative approach to executing tailored, goal-oriented strategies.

### **5. Revity Marketing**
Location: 1261 S 820 E, Suite 100, American Fork

![revity, digital marketing in utah](https://recruitingconnection.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/images-1-2.png)

[Revity Marketing](https://gorevity.com/) functions seamlessly as an extended in-house department for small to mid-sized businesses.

A major advantage of working with them is their dedicated internal creative team. Handling photography and videography internally provides your brand with a constant stream of fresh social assets, bypassing the high costs associated with hiring a separate production studio.

### **7. Rock Salt Marketing Cooperative**
Location: 1240B E Stringham Ave, #1012, Salt Lake City

![rock salt marketing cooperative, digital marketing salt lake city](https://recruitingconnection.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Rock-Salt-Marketing-Cooperative-logo-profile.jpg)

[Rock Salt Marketing Cooperative](https://rocksaltmarketing.com/) disrupts standard industry structures right out of Salt Lake City. Founded in 2023, the agency operates as an employee-owned cooperative, meaning every team member has a direct financial stake in your campaign’s success. This people-first philosophy translates directly into their service quality.

They maintain 100% positive client feedback, with roughly 70% of reviews specifically highlighting effective project management and clear communication. Spanning industries from home services to property management, they offer transparent, relationship-driven service to drive sustainable digital growth.

## **Top** **5** **In-Demand Digital Marketing Skills**
### **1. AI and automation fluency**
You want an operator who leverages smart tools to multiply their daily output, regardless of your business sector.

### **4. Technical SEO and entity optimization**
You need a specialist who understands how to structure site data correctly so machine learning models grasp your exact offerings, ensuring your brand gets cited directly in AI-generated overviews.

# Digital Marketing in Utah: Top Agencies + Skills Employers Want
## **Top 7** **Digital Marketing Agencies in Utah**
### **1. Disruptive Advertising**
Location: 1064 N County Blvd Ste 400, Pleasant Grove

![disruptive, digital marketing agency utah](https://recruitingconnection.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/disruptive-logo.png)

[Disruptive Advertising](https://disruptiveadvertising.com/) recently won the 2025 Marketing Company of the Year at the Silicon Slopes Hall of Fame Awards. They pair their deep expertise in Google and Meta ads with conversion rate optimization, creative strategy, and lifecycle marketing.

It’s one of the digital marketing agencies you start with if you need aggressive, data-backed growth across multiple online channels.

### **2. Big Red Jelly**
Location: 2520 N University Ave, Provo

![big red jelly, digital marketing utah](https://recruitingconnection.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/logo-1.png)

Sending traffic to a poorly designed website drains your budget. [Big Red Jelly](https://bigredjelly.com/), which follows an award-winning _Brand, Build, Grow_ methodology, combines web design, SEO, and PPC to ensure your visual identity and website architecture convert visitors into buyers.

They’re an ideal partner when you need an enterprise-grade digital foundation for a rebrand or a new venture. Clients consistently highlight their collaborative approach to executing tailored, goal-oriented strategies.

### **5. Revity Marketing**
Location: 1261 S 820 E, Suite 100, American Fork

![revity, digital marketing in utah](https://recruitingconnection.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/images-1-2.png)

[Revity Marketing](https://gorevity.com/) functions seamlessly as an extended in-house department for small to mid-sized businesses.

A major advantage of working with them is their dedicated internal creative team. Handling photography and videography internally provides your brand with a constant stream of fresh social assets, bypassing the high costs associated with hiring a separate production studio.

### **7. Rock Salt Marketing Cooperative**
Location: 1240B E Stringham Ave, #1012, Salt Lake City

![rock salt marketing cooperative, digital marketing salt lake city](https://recruitingconnection.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Rock-Salt-Marketing-Cooperative-logo-profile.jpg)

[Rock Salt Marketing Cooperative](https://rocksaltmarketing.com/) disrupts standard industry structures right out of Salt Lake City. Founded in 2023, the agency operates as an employee-owned cooperative, meaning every team member has a direct financial stake in your campaign’s success. This people-first philosophy translates directly into their service quality.

They maintain 100% positive client feedback, with roughly 70% of reviews specifically highlighting effective project management and clear communication. Spanning industries from home services to property management, they offer transparent, relationship-driven service to drive sustainable digital growth.

## **Top** **5** **In-Demand Digital Marketing Skills**
### **1. AI and automation fluency**
You want an operator who leverages smart tools to multiply their daily output, regardless of your business sector.

### **4. Technical SEO and entity optimization**
You need a specialist who understands how to structure site data correctly so machine learning models grasp your exact offerings, ensuring your brand gets cited directly in AI-generated overviews.
